resources.string: Your Boson identity is a key that is you on the Boson network. This app keeps it on this phone, under your control, and uses it to approve your devices and protect your account.
The picture and the id belong to your new key, made on this phone. Nobody else has it. Next, save a copy of it.
If you lose this phone and have no copy of this key, no one, not even us, can get your identity back. Save it in at least one way, somewhere only you can reach.
Your private key as a QR code
Copied. The clipboard is cleared in %1$d seconds.
Anyone with this key can act as you. Never send it to anyone, and never type it into a website.
To show your key, confirm with your screen lock.
Your private key will be shown so you can back it up
From the copy you saved, type the characters at these two places. This proves the copy is complete.
That doesn\'t match. Check your copy, or look at the key again.
Use the key you saved: its file, its QR code, or its text.
That is not a usable Boson key. Check that the whole key was copied.
Is your identity on another phone you still have? Move it from there.
Your key is kept encrypted on this phone. Every time it is used to act for you, the phone asks for your fingerprint or screen lock first.
Your backup is not checked yet. Until it is, this identity can\'t approve anything.
This phone has no screen lock. Set one first: without it, your key can\'t be protected.
Your key will be stored encrypted on this phone
Your identity is yours wherever you go. Your home node is where your account and devices are kept. Scan the node\'s QR code, or type its address.
Needed when the node uses a self-signed certificate.
That QR code is not a Boson node\'s.
That is not a valid node id.
If this node already knows your identity, this phone is added to it. If not, an account is made for you; the node first runs a short security check on this phone.
This node adds new accounts only through a linked account, which this app can\'t do yet. If it already knows your identity, this phone is added to it.
Shown to people you talk to through this node.
This node doesn\'t know your identity, and doesn\'t take new accounts this way.
This can take a minute while the node\'s security check runs.
Your account on this node has a passphrase. Adding this phone needs it.
Your identity will be used at %1$s
First, choose your home node: scan its QR code, or type its address. Your old phone shows it in Account.
Approve this phone on your old phone
On your old phone, open Boson Identity, go to Devices, tap \"Approve a new device\" and scan this code. It asks for your identity\'s key: approve it there.
Pairing code for your old phone
Or paste this code on the old phone:
Waiting for your old phone. The code works for 3 minutes.
Storing your identity on this phone...
Your old phone approved this one, but storing the key here didn\'t work. Try again, and confirm with your screen lock.
This phone was not added to your identity. If that was a mistake, try again.
Your old phone didn\'t approve this one in time. Try again to get a new code.
Your old phone approved this one but didn\'t hand over your identity\'s key. Try again, and approve the new code.
This identity is already on this phone.
